verdict.reasons: The product correctly exhibits the authorized AFP drip tape carton roll (tape20) without mixed products, people, or fake branding. However, the core technical evidence requirements are not met: the pressure gauge does not have its face angled away (it displays a readable/invented scale), and the installed drip-tape lateral is depicted as an unsupported coiled ring on the soil rather than a connected take-off fitting on a continuous irrigation header. These technical/visual defects drop the image below the 90-point threshold.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad, uninterrupted gap of soil is clearly visible around the complete footprint of the white-and-blue AFP package. No lines touch or cross the base of the carton; the black irrigation ring and gauge assembly are physically separated by a significant distance. Only the required single AFP package is present, with no additional loose coils visible. A close inspection of the package shows no protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails emerging from the carton sides or base.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
